attempts.text:
**The window starts in a long persistent stretch.** Columns 0 to 25, `ppiA` to `tuf`, are spine, carried by 96 to 100% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 3% of calls. The model names 54 to 100% of genes there, mean 96%, fewest at column 19 (`tusD`), 54%; no column hesitates more than 0.17 bits.

**Column 26 is variable**, `chiA`, in a region of plasticity in 0.4% of calls, named 87%, 0.48 bits, the most hesitant column of the window. Then columns 27 to 28, `bfd` and `bfr`, are spine, carried by 97% of chromosomes, named 98%, no column above 0.09 bits.

**The `gsp` operon, [[type II secretion system proteins]], fills variable columns 29 to 42**, carried by 65 to 72% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 47 to 71% of calls. The model names 94 to 100% there, mean 97%, fewest at column 40 (`gspC`), 94%; column 39 (`gspD`) is most hesitant at 0.33 bits.

**The window ends in a long persistent stretch.** Columns 43 to 79, `rpsJ` to `dprA`, are spine, carried by 90 to 97% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 4% of calls, named 96 to 100%, mean 99%. Across the window the model names 98% of genes at 0.07 bits; inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.24 against 0.05 bits, and names about as many genes, 96% against 98%.

label: ppiA
facts:
WINDOW: the ppiA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor ppiA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 356 to 435 from dnaA. Read in 539 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying ppiA once); 43,120 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 98% of genes, 0.07 bits on average (perplexity 1.1 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 36,836 calls, named 98%, 0.04 bits; shell 6,276 calls, named 94%, 0.28 bits; cloud 8 calls, named 0%, 1.26 bits. Outside an RGP 37,714 calls, named 98%, 0.05 bits; inside an RGP 5,406 calls, named 96%, 0.24 bits. Columns: 65 spine, 0 fork, 15 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.24 against 0.05 bits) and names about as many genes (96% against 98%); 5,406 of the 43,120 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 26 (chiA) 0.48 bits, RGP 0.4%; column 39 (gspD) 0.33 bits, RGP 69%; column 40 (gspC) 0.30 bits, RGP 69%. The 13 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 97%, 0.17 bits on average; the other 67 columns: named 98%, 0.06 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 29-42 (variable), RGP 47-71%; the least: columns 43-79 (spine), RGP 0-4%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-25 (26 columns) spine: share 96-100%, all P, RGP 0-3%. Genes: ppiA, yhfG "YhfG family protein", fic, pabA, argD, yhfK "YccS/YhfK family putative transport…", crp, yhfA "OsmC family protein", prkB, yheU "YheU family protein", yheT "hydrolase", yheS "ATP-binding cassette domain-contain…", kefG, kefB "monovalent cation:proton antiporter…", yheV "YheV family putative zinc ribbon pr…", slyD "peptidylprolyl isomerase", slyX, fkpA, yheO "transcriptional regulator", tusD "sulfurtransferase complex subunit T…", tusC, tusB, rpsL, rpsG "30S ribosomal protein S7", fusA, tuf. named 54-100% (mean 96%), fewest named at column 19 (tusD), named 54%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.17 bits (column 13 (kefB)).
2. column 26 variable: RGP 0.4%. named 87%; 0.48 bits.
   26: chiA S 67%
3. columns 27-28 (2 columns) spine: share 97%, all P, RGP 1-7%. Genes: bfd, bfr. named 98%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.09 bits (column 27 (bfd)).
4. columns 29-42 (14 columns) variable: RGP 47-71%. named 94-100% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 40, named 94%; most hesitant at column 39, 0.33 bits.
   columns 29-42, share 65-72%, all S: gspO 68%, gspM 71%, gspL 69%, gspK 68%, gspJ "type II secretion system minor pseu…" 68%, gspI 70%, gspH 70%, gspG 70%, gspF 68%, gspE 68%, gspD 65%, gspC 65%, gspA 65%, gspB 72%
5. columns 43-79 (37 columns) spine: share 90-97%, all P, RGP 0-4%. Genes: rpsJ, rplC "50S ribosomal protein L3", rplD, rplW, rplB, rpsS, rplV, rpsC, rplP, rpmC, rpsQ, rplN, rplX, rplE "50S ribosomal protein L5", rpsN, rpsH "30S ribosomal protein S8", rplF "50S ribosomal protein L6", rplR, rpsE, rpmD, rplO, secY, rpmJ, rpsM, rpsK, rpsD "30S ribosomal protein S4", rpoA, rplQ, yhdN "DUF1992 domain-containing protein", zntR, arfA, mscL, trkA, rsmB, fmt, def, dprA. named 96-100% (mean 99%), fewest named at column 78 (def), named 96%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.18 bits (column 77 (fmt)).
